newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Jan-March industrial output seen up 2.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Japan Jan-March industrial output seen up 2.9 pct.

text.p: Japan"s industrial output for the January-March period is expected to rise 2.9 percent from the previous quarter, a Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) official said on Monday.
The figure compares with a quarter-on-quarter rise of 3.2 percent in the October-December quarter.
Industrial output for the January-March period is expected to rise 7.6 percent against the same period a year ago, the official told reporters.
The official said the trend of rising industrial production had not changed.
